_meta.name: Nexus Hub classifier golden set
_meta.purpose: Offline evaluation harness for Option 3 (small dedicated Ollama classifier). Replaces Gemini-as-truth with reviewer-decided ground truth.
notes: 100 examples total: 20 per domain + 10 ambiguous + 10 follow-up.
All `domain` fields are reviewer-decided ground truth. NOT Gemini output.
Ambiguous entries (id starts with 'ambig-') test the reviewer's decision against the model.
Follow-up entries (id starts with 'followup-') test that activeContext is honored.
Tool-domain recall (secretary, triathlon) >= 95% required per O3-A24.
